labels.label: lem:kobayashi
labels.notes: Unmarked and partial, as the dispatch requires. Part (a) only. DEFINITIONS vs the paper. action = ∫ R vol_g + 2(N−1) Σ_j ∫ H bvol_j is eq:EH-action (l.305–307), with ∂Σ = ⊔B_j as a sum. EH = action / Vol^{(N−2)/N} is eq:yamabe-energy-bdry (l.310–311). confAction u = a_N·dirichlet u + ∫ R u² vol + 2(N−1) Σ_j ∫ H (tr u)² bvol_j is the right side of eq:conformal-energy-bdry (l.326–328), split into two integrals. a_N = 4(N−1)/(N−2), p* = 2N/(N−2) and the exponents 2/N, (N−2)/N are the strict library's (Quotient.lean:107–113). confEnergy u = confAction u / ‖u‖²_{p*} is the left side of eq:kobayashi through the conformal law. Since Vol(Σ, φ^{4/(N−2)}g)^{(N−2)/N} = ‖φ‖²_{p*}, this is the law's quotient. EH_eq_confEnergy_one proves the law at φ = 1. JUNK. normSq = 0 when ‖u‖_{p*} is 0 or ∞, and then both sides of kobayashi reduce to m·Vol^{2/N} ≤ 0. When 0 < ‖u‖_{p*} < ∞, which is the paper's case u ∈ W^{1,2}∖{0}, the proof goes through MemLp and scalar_term_ge. The scalar integral is genuine there (integrable_R_mul_sq: R bounded, L^{p*} ⊂ L² on a finite measure), so the non-integrable branch of scalar_term_ge is dead. A junk dirichlet (infinite energy, u ∉ W^{1,2}) appears on both sides and leaves the plain Hölder bound mVol^{2/N}‖u‖² ≤ ∫Ru², which is true. So kobayashi is not trivially true. At u = 1 on the toy it is an equality (EH = Y = kobM·Vol^{2/3}), so no stronger form could hold. Y'S DOMAIN. Y = sInf confEnergy over {Pos u (val u > 0 everywhere) ∧ Adm u (0 < ‖u‖²_{p*}, i.e. finite and nonzero)}. This set does not make le_Y easier: le_infConf proves the bound over every S ⊆ D, and the empty or unbounded-below junk of Real.sInf is handled by Real.le_sInf with m·Vol^{2/N} ≤ 0. Y_le_EH needs only that M.one is a competitor, which holds for any reasonable reading of φ > 0. HYPOTHESES vs l.605, l.615–622. N ≥ 3 is carried. Compactness becomes IsFiniteMeasure vol_g. hD (every val u a.e.-strongly measurable) holds for D ⊆ W^{1,2}. MinimalBoundary (H = 0 bvol_j-a.e. for every j) weakens H ≡ 0, and ∂Σ = ∅ implies it (minimalBoundary_of_bvol_eq_zero; n = 0 vacuously). kobayashi takes any m ≤ 0 with m ≤ R a.e. The printed m is kobM = min 0 (⨅ x, R x), a genuine infimum because R is bounded (bddBelow_R, kobM_le). Constant R becomes R = c a.e. with c ≤ 0. Connectedness is not used. Nothing is strengthened. CONCLUSIONS. lem_kobayashi_a gives (i) eq:kobayashi for every u : D with the printed m; (ii) the 'in particular', kobM·Vol^{2/N} ≤ Y; (iii) for every c ≤ 0 with R = c a.e., EH = Y and Y = c·Vol^{2/N}. That is part (a) with its 'in particular' and the constant-curvature sentence, plus the value used at l.724. CurvedMetric has fields R, H, measurability and boundedness: data, no hidden conclusion. That R and H are the curvatures of G is disclosed as part of the anchoring (T-yamabe-scope). The auxiliary Y_le_EH carries hV, hD and hH, which the paper's unconditional 'Y ≤ EH' (l.423) does not need. Lean needs hD and hH for BddBelow in csInf_le, and hV is redundant. No label rests on Y_le_EH alone: EH_eq_Y and the assembly do not carry hV. WITNESS. toyCurved (two-point toyModel, G = 1, R ≡ −1, H ≡ 0) satisfies every hypothesis: toy_minimal, toy_isFiniteMeasure, hD by discreteness. An auditor probe applied lem_kobayashi_a itself to it, and it elaborated. EH = Y = −2^{2/3} ≠ 0, toy_kobM = −1. Both REPORT findings are true. See build.details for finding 1. Finding 2 (l.617–620): u^{4/(N−2)}g is a metric only for u > 0, and N = 10 gives u^{1/2}. The uses of the inequality for general u (l.622, l.660) take u > 0. The other uses (l.202, l.334, l.645, l.724) use only EH = Y. It is a wording point, correctly graded minor.

findings.what: Two checklist rows are marked ✓ although they are readings. The REPORT and SCOPE say so. (a) '`R_g`, `H_g` … ✓ carried as bounded measurable fields of `CurvedMetric`': R and H are free data, not computed from G. SCOPE l.82–83 says so ('That they are the curvatures of g is part of the anchoring'). (b) '`φ > 0` in eq:relative-yamabe | ✓ `Pos u` …, `Adm`': the REPORT's own hypothesis row marks Y's domain 'reading'. φ's regularity is unspecified (D is arbitrary), Pos is positivity at every point of X, and Adm adds 0 < ‖u‖²_{p*} < ∞. Nothing proved depends on these marks: le_infConf holds over every competitor set, and EH_eq_Y needs only M.one. But the checklist should match the REPORT.
findings.fix: Mark both rows '⚠ read (SCOPE)': R_g, H_g as data of the metric (anchoring, T-yamabe-scope), and φ > 0 as Pos ∧ Adm over an abstract D.
